o1a: All Scripture is inspired by God.
o1b: It is to be applied to our lives.
o2b: The Word cuts (hurts) — compare it to a scalpel.
o2c: It is good to be cut because it cuts the "cancer" (sin) out.
o3a: There is no private interpretation of the Bible.
o3b: The Holy Spirit inspired the men who wrote the books of the Bible.
o4a: Intellectual belief is not enough — nor can we go by our feelings.
o4b: A person must hold on to and follow the teachings of Jesus to be a true disciple.
o5a: Do not go by traditions or creeds.
o5b: Worship by traditions (which supersede the Word of God) is worship in vain.
o6a: Watch your life and doctrine closely — they are inseparable.
o6b: Which is more important, life or doctrine? Both: An airplane with only one wing cannot fly.
o6c: Why is it so important to learn and to teach and to live the right doctrine? To save yourself and those who hear you.
o7a: Must check what religious leaders say.
o7b: Your challenge: Read and study the Bible every day.
o8a: The Word of God is a mirror.
o8b: Do not forget what you see — "do what it says."
o9a: Why study the Bible? The Word will judge us.
decision: Decision: Will I live by the Bible or my feelings, traditions, needs, etc.?
